==Acquisition==
'''[[Skill quest]]s'''
*[[Attack on Jalis's Camp]] (from [[Orozar Highstone]] in [[Battledepths]])

==Notes==
* Best used by a support character, especially [[Ritualists]], as their [[Spawning Power]] increases [[Weapon_spell#Spawning_Power_duration_breakpoints|duration of weapon spells]], and they have many skills that positively interact with weapon spells.
** Non-Ritualist players can use [[of the (Profession)|of the Ritualist]] suffixes to increase the duration by up to 20%, i.e. another 4 seconds.
* If used with a [[scythe]] or [[Attack#Skills dealing multiple attacks|attack skills that can hit multiple foes]] (such as [[Barrage]] or [[Whirlwind Attack]]), add [[Earthbind]] for long-lasting [[shutdown]] of multiple enemies; including foes otherwise [[Stun Immunity|immune to knock down]].
* While the skill mentions it only works on weapons, [[pet]]s will get the effects as well.

==Trivia==
*The words "Bork! Bork! Bork!" appear at the end of this skill's [[Bork! Bork! Bork!]] non-[[concise description]].
